hooks.name: Lint on Save (src, 15s debounce)

action.command: d="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/mathman-lint"; mkdir -p "$d"; tok="$$-$RANDOM-$(date +%s)"; printf '%s' "$tok" > "$d/token"; sleep 15; [ "$(cat "$d/token" 2>/dev/null)" = "$tok" ] && npm run lint

hooks.description: Runs `npm run lint` after a JS/TS file under src/ is saved, but only once no further save has occurred for 15 seconds (debounced via a token file).
